source.text: וְאֵ֤לֶּה הַגּוֹיִם֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר הִנִּ֣יחַ יְהוָ֔ה לְנַסּ֥וֹת בָּ֖ם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל אֵ֚ת כָּל־אֲשֶׁ֣ר לֹֽא־יָדְע֔וּ אֵ֖ת כָּל־מִלְחֲמ֥וֹת כְּנָֽעַן׃

records.literal_gloss: And these [are] the nations that left Yahweh to test by them Israel, all who not had known all [the] wars of Canaan,

en.L: And these [are] the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} left, to test Israel by them, all who had not known any of the wars of Canaan,
en.B: These are the nations that {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} left in the land to test Israel by them, that is, all those in Israel who had never known any of the wars for Canaan.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} left some nations in the land. He used them to test the Israelites who had never fought in the wars to win Canaan.

sw.L: Na haya [ndiyo] mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyaacha, ili kwa hayo amjaribu Israeli, yaani wote ambao hawakujua vita vyovyote vya Kanaani,
sw.B: Haya ndiyo mataifa ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyaacha katika nchi ili kwa hayo awajaribu Israeli, yaani, wale wote katika Israeli ambao hawakuwa wamejua vita vyovyote vya kuitwaa Kanaani.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliacha mataifa kadhaa katika nchi. Aliyatumia kuwajaribu Waisraeli ambao hawakuwa wamepigana katika vita vya kuitwaa Kanaani.

es.L: Y estas [son] las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dejó para probar por medio de ellas a Israel, a todos los que no habían conocido ninguna de las guerras de Canaán,
es.B: Estas son las naciones que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dejó en la tierra para probar por medio de ellas a Israel, es decir, a todos los de Israel que nunca habían conocido ninguna de las guerras por Canaán.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} dejó algunas naciones en la tierra. Las usó para probar a los israelitas que nunca habían peleado en las guerras para conquistar Canaán.

fr.L: Et voici les nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} laissa pour éprouver Israël par elles, tous ceux qui n’avaient connu aucune des guerres de Canaan,
fr.B: Voici les nations que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} laissa dans le pays pour mettre Israël à l’épreuve par elles, c’est-à-dire tous ceux d’Israël qui n’avaient connu aucune des guerres pour Canaan.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a laissé quelques nations dans le pays. Il s’en est servi pour mettre à l’épreuve les Israélites qui n’avaient jamais pris part aux guerres pour conquérir Canaan.

vi.L: Và đây [là] các dân tộc mà {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã để lại, để nhờ chúng thử Y-sơ-ra-ên, tức là tất cả những người chưa từng biết một cuộc chiến nào ở Ca-na-an,
vi.B: Đây là các dân tộc {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để lại trong xứ để nhờ chúng thử Y-sơ-ra-ên, tức là tất cả những người Y-sơ-ra-ên chưa từng biết đến một cuộc chiến nào để chiếm Ca-na-an.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} để lại một số dân tộc trong xứ. Ngài dùng các dân ấy để thử những người Y-sơ-ra-ên chưa từng đánh trận nào để giành lấy đất Ca-na-an.

ko.L: 그리고 이들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 남겨 두신 민족들[이다]. 가나안의 모든 전쟁을 알지 못한 모든 이스라엘을 그들로 시험하시려는 것이었다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그 땅에 남겨 두신 민족들은 다음과 같다. 주님께서는 그들을 통해 이스라엘을 시험하려고 하셨다. 곧 가나안을 차지하려고 벌인 전쟁을 전혀 겪어 보지 못한 이스라엘 사람들을 시험하려는 것이었다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 몇몇 민족을 그 땅에 남겨 두셨다. 주님께서는 그들을 통해, 가나안 땅을 얻으려고 싸운 전쟁에 한 번도 나가 보지 못한 이스라엘 사람들을 시험하셨다.

pt.L: E estas [são] as nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deixou, para provar Israel por meio delas, todos os que não tinham conhecido nenhuma das guerras de Canaã,
pt.B: Estas são as nações que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deixou na terra para provar Israel por meio delas, isto é, todos os israelitas que nunca tinham conhecido nenhuma das guerras por Canaã.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} deixou algumas nações na terra. Usou essas nações para pôr à prova os israelitas que nunca tinham lutado nas guerras para conquistar Canaã.

decisions.choice: God left these nations in the land on purpose, as a test
decisions.reason: Because Israel broke the covenant, God said he would no longer drive out the nations Joshua left, but would use them to test whether Israel would keep his way (2:20-23). Verse 4 states the test again.

decisions.choice: had not known the wars of Canaan: had no experience of the fighting by which the land was taken
decisions.reason: "Know" here means to know by experience. These are the generation that grew up after Joshua and did not see what the LORD had done for Israel (2:10).

decisions.choice: He used them to test
decisions.reason: Readable splits the sentence in two and makes the purpose a sentence of its own, with God as the one who tests.

source.text: רַ֗ק לְמַ֨עַן֙ דַּ֚עַת דֹּר֣וֹת בְּנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לְלַמְּדָ֖ם מִלְחָמָ֑ה רַ֥ק אֲשֶׁר־לְפָנִ֖ים לֹ֥א יְדָעֽוּם׃

records.literal_gloss: only so as to know [the] generations of [the] sons of Israel, to teach them war, only those who before not had known them,

en.L: only so that the generations of the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel might know [it], to teach them war, only those who had not known them before,
en.B: He did this only so that the generations of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} would learn about war, at least those who had never experienced it before.
en.R: He did it so that each new generation of the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} would learn how to fight, especially those who had never been in a battle.

sw.L: ili tu vizazi vya wana wa Israeli vijue, kuwafundisha vita, angalau wale ambao hawakuvijua hapo kwanza,
sw.B: Alifanya hivyo ili tu vizazi vya Waisraeli vijifunze vita, angalau wale ambao hawakuwa wamevijua hapo kwanza.
sw.R: Alifanya hivyo ili kila kizazi kipya cha Waisraeli kijifunze jinsi ya kupigana, hasa wale ambao hawakuwahi kuwa vitani.

es.L: solamente para que las generaciones de los hijos de Israel [la] conocieran, para enseñarles la guerra, solamente a los que antes no la habían conocido:
es.B: Lo hizo solamente para que las generaciones de los israelitas aprendieran a hacer la guerra, al menos los que nunca antes la habían vivido.
es.R: Lo hizo para que cada nueva generación de israelitas aprendiera a pelear, sobre todo los que nunca habían estado en una batalla.

fr.L: seulement afin que les générations des {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël [la] connaissent, pour leur enseigner la guerre, seulement ceux qui auparavant ne l’avaient pas connue :
fr.B: Il le fit seulement pour que les générations des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} apprennent ce qu’est la guerre, du moins ceux qui ne l’avaient jamais connue auparavant.
fr.R: Il l’a fait pour que chaque nouvelle génération des {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} apprenne à combattre, surtout ceux qui n’avaient jamais participé à une bataille.

vi.L: chỉ để các thế hệ của con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên được biết [chiến tranh], để dạy họ chiến trận, chỉ những người trước kia chưa từng biết đến.
vi.B: Ngài làm vậy chỉ để các thế hệ của dân Y-sơ-ra-ên học biết chiến trận, ít ra là những người trước đó chưa từng trải qua.
vi.R: Ngài làm vậy để mỗi thế hệ mới của dân Y-sơ-ra-ên học biết cách chiến đấu, nhất là những người chưa từng ra trận.

ko.L: 다만 이스라엘 자손의 세대들이 [그것을] 알게 하려고, 그들에게 전쟁을 가르치려는 것이었다. 다만 전에 그것을 알지 못한 사람들에게였다.
ko.B: 주님께서 이렇게 하신 것은 다만 이스라엘 백성의 세대들이 전쟁을 배우게 하시려는 것이었다. 적어도 전에 전쟁을 겪어 보지 못한 사람들만이라도 배우게 하시려는 것이었다.
ko.R: 주님께서 그렇게 하신 것은 이스라엘 백성의 새 세대마다 싸우는 법을 배우게 하시려는 것이었다. 특히 한 번도 싸움터에 나가 보지 못한 사람들이 배우게 하시려는 것이었다.

pt.L: somente para que as gerações dos filhos de Israel [a] conhecessem, para lhes ensinar a guerra, somente os que antes não as tinham conhecido,
pt.B: Ele fez isso apenas para que as gerações dos israelitas aprendessem a guerra, pelo menos aqueles que nunca a tinham conhecido antes.
pt.R: Ele fez isso para que cada nova geração dos israelitas aprendesse a lutar, principalmente os que nunca tinham estado numa batalha.

decisions.choice: only ... only: the purpose is limited to teaching war to those who had no experience of it
decisions.reason: The word "only" comes twice. It narrows the purpose: the nations were left so that later generations, at least those who had not known war, would learn it. This stands beside the test of obedience in verses 1 and 4; the text does not say how the two purposes relate.

decisions.choice: to know ... to teach them war: to learn by experience how to fight
decisions.reason: "Know" again means experience, as in verse 1. A generation that never had to fight would now have to learn it with the nations still in the land.

decisions.choice: He did this
decisions.reason: The Hebrew continues the sentence of verse 1 with "only so that". Balanced and Readable start a new sentence and supply the subject and verb.

source.text: חֲמֵ֣שֶׁת׀סַרְנֵ֣י פְלִשְׁתִּ֗ים וְכָל־הַֽכְּנַעֲנִי֙ וְהַצִּ֣ידֹנִ֔י וְהַ֣חִוִּ֔י יֹשֵׁ֖ב הַ֣ר הַלְּבָנ֑וֹן מֵהַר֙ בַּ֣עַל חֶרְמ֔וֹן עַ֖ד לְב֥וֹא חֲמָֽת׃

records.literal_gloss: five rulers of [the] Philistines, and all the Canaanite[s], and the Sidonian[s], and the Hivite[s] dwelling [in the] mountain of the Lebanon, from [the] mountain of Baal-hermon as far as Lebo-hamath.

en.L: the five rulers of [the] Philistines, and all the Canaanites, and the Sidonians, and the Hivites living [in] the mountains of Lebanon, from Mount Baal-hermon as far as Lebo-hamath.
en.B: These were the five rulers of the Philistines, all the Canaanites and Sidonians, and the Hivites living in the Lebanon mountains from Mount Baal-hermon to Lebo-hamath.
en.R: They were the five Philistine rulers, all the Canaanites, the Sidonians, and the Hivites. The Hivites lived in the mountains of Lebanon, from Mount Baal-hermon all the way to Lebo-hamath.

sw.L: watawala watano wa Wafilisti, na Wakanaani wote, na Wasidoni, na Wahivi waliokaa [katika] milima ya Lebanoni, kutoka Mlima Baal-hermoni mpaka Lebo-hamathi.
sw.B: Hao walikuwa watawala watano wa Wafilisti, Wakanaani wote na Wasidoni, na Wahivi waliokaa katika milima ya Lebanoni kutoka Mlima Baal-hermoni mpaka Lebo-hamathi.
sw.R: Walikuwa watawala watano wa Wafilisti, Wakanaani wote, Wasidoni na Wahivi. Wahivi waliishi katika milima ya Lebanoni, kutoka Mlima Baal-hermoni mpaka Lebo-hamathi.

es.L: los cinco gobernantes de [los] filisteos, y todos los cananeos, y los sidonios, y los heveos que habitaban [en] los montes del Líbano, desde el monte Baal-hermón hasta Lebo-hamat.
es.B: Eran los cinco gobernantes de los filisteos, todos los cananeos y los sidonios, y los heveos que vivían en los montes del Líbano, desde el monte Baal-hermón hasta Lebo-hamat.
es.R: Eran los cinco gobernantes filisteos, todos los cananeos, los sidonios y los heveos. Los heveos vivían en los montes del Líbano, desde el monte Baal-hermón hasta Lebo-hamat.

fr.L: les cinq princes des Philistins, et tous les Cananéens, et les Sidoniens, et les Héviens qui habitaient la montagne du Liban, depuis la montagne de Baal-Hermon jusqu’à Lebo-Hamath.
fr.B: C’étaient les cinq princes des Philistins, tous les Cananéens et les Sidoniens, et les Héviens qui habitaient les montagnes du Liban, du mont Baal-Hermon jusqu’à Lebo-Hamath.
fr.R: C’étaient les cinq chefs des Philistins, tous les Cananéens, les Sidoniens et les Héviens. Les Héviens vivaient dans les montagnes du Liban, depuis le mont Baal-Hermon jusqu’à Lebo-Hamath.

vi.L: năm lãnh chúa của [người] Phi-li-tin, và tất cả người Ca-na-an, và người Si-đôn, và người Hê-vít sống [trên] núi Li-ban, từ núi Ba-anh-Hẹt-môn cho đến Lê-bô Ha-mát.
vi.B: Đó là năm lãnh chúa của người Phi-li-tin, tất cả người Ca-na-an và người Si-đôn, cùng người Hê-vít sống trong dãy núi Li-ban, từ núi Ba-anh-Hẹt-môn cho đến Lê-bô Ha-mát.
vi.R: Đó là năm lãnh chúa của người Phi-li-tin, tất cả người Ca-na-an, người Si-đôn và người Hê-vít. Người Hê-vít sống trong vùng núi Li-ban, từ núi Ba-anh-Hẹt-môn cho đến tận Lê-bô Ha-mát.

ko.L: 블레셋의 다섯 통치자와 모든 가나안 사람들과 시돈 사람들과 바알헤르몬 산에서부터 하맛 어귀까지 레바논 산지에 사는 히위 사람들이었다.
ko.B: 그들은 블레셋의 다섯 통치자와 모든 가나안 사람과 시돈 사람, 그리고 바알헤르몬 산에서 하맛 어귀까지 레바논 산지에 사는 히위 사람들이었다.
ko.R: 그들은 블레셋의 다섯 통치자와 모든 가나안 사람과 시돈 사람과 히위 사람이었다. 히위 사람들은 바알헤르몬 산에서부터 하맛 어귀까지 이르는 레바논 산지에 살았다.

pt.L: os cinco príncipes dos filisteus, e todos os cananeus, e os sidônios, e os heveus que habitavam [nas] montanhas do Líbano, desde o monte Baal-Hermom até Lebo-Hamate.
pt.B: Eram os cinco governantes dos filisteus, todos os cananeus e os sidônios, e os heveus que viviam nas montanhas do Líbano, desde o monte Baal-Hermom até Lebo-Hamate.
pt.R: Eram os cinco governantes dos filisteus, todos os cananeus, os sidônios e os heveus. Os heveus viviam nas montanhas do Líbano, desde o monte Baal-Hermom até Lebo-Hamate.

decisions.choice: rulers: the lords of the five Philistine cities
decisions.reason: This title is used only of the Philistine leaders. Each ruled one of their five cities on the coastal plain: Gaza, Ashdod, Ashkelon, Gath and Ekron (Joshua 13:3; 1 Samuel 6:17).

decisions.choice: Sidonians and Hivites: the peoples of the coast and mountains in the north
decisions.reason: The Sidonians were the people of Sidon and the Phoenician coast. The Hivites here live in the Lebanon range, so this list covers the southwest (the Philistines) and the far north, land Israel had not taken (Joshua 13:2-6).

decisions.choice: Lebo-hamath: a town on the northern border
decisions.reason: The name can be read as a town, Lebo of Hamath, or as a phrase, "the entrance to Hamath". Both point to the same northern limit of the promised land (Numbers 34:8). Baal-hermon is probably Mount Hermon or a peak near it (1 Chronicles 5:23).

decisions.choice: "los cinco gobernantes de los filisteos"
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is a special title for the lords of the five Philistine cities (m1). "Gobernantes" says what they were without making them kings or princes, as the English "rulers" does.

decisions.choice: "les cinq princes des Philistins" (L, B); "les cinq chefs" (R)
decisions.reason: The Hebrew word is a title used only for the lords of the five Philistine cities. "Princes" says that they were rulers without making them kings; Readable says "chefs", as the English says "rulers".

decisions.choice: "lãnh chúa" for the Philistine rulers
decisions.reason: The Hebrew has a special title for the lords of the five Philistine cities (m1); "lãnh chúa" (lord, ruler) marks it as different from "vua" (king). Kept wherever the Philistine lords appear.

decisions.choice: os cinco príncipes (L), governantes (B, R) dos filisteus; os sidônios; os heveus
decisions.reason: For the whole book (also 16:5-30): the Philistine title (m1) keeps the Portuguese of Joshua 13:3, "príncipes" at Literal and "governantes" at Balanced and Readable; "os filisteus", "os sidônios" and "os heveus" are the forms Genesis, Deuteronomy 3:9 and Joshua use. "Lebo-Hamate" as Numbers 34:8.

source.text: וַֽיִּהְי֕וּ לְנַסּ֥וֹת בָּ֖ם אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לָדַ֗עַת הֲיִשְׁמְעוּ֙ אֶת־מִצְוֺ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה אֲשֶׁר־צִוָּ֥ה אֶת־אֲבוֹתָ֖ם בְּיַד־מֹשֶֽׁה׃

records.literal_gloss: And they were to test by them Israel, to know whether they would hear [the] commandments of Yahweh which he commanded their fathers by [the] hand of Moses.

en.L: And they were [there] to test Israel by them, to know whether they would listen to the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had commanded their fathers by the hand of Moses.
en.B: They were left to test Israel, to find out whether the Israelites would obey the commandments of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, which {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had given their ancestors through Moses.
en.R: {{divine_name:The LORD|Yahweh}} used these nations to test Israel. He wanted to see whether the Israelites would obey the commands {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} had given their ancestors through Moses.

sw.L: Nao walikuwa [huko] ili kwa hao amjaribu Israeli, ajue kama wangezisikiliza amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, alizowaamuru baba zao kwa mkono wa Musa.
sw.B: Waliachwa ili kuwajaribu Israeli, ili ijulikane kama Waisraeli wangezitii amri za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, alizowapa mababu zao kupitia Musa.
sw.R: {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} aliyatumia mataifa hayo kuwajaribu Israeli. Alitaka kuona kama Waisraeli wangezitii amri alizowapa mababu zao kupitia Musa.

es.L: Y estaban [allí] para probar por medio de ellos a Israel, para saber si escucharían los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había ordenado a sus padres por mano de Moisés.
es.B: Fueron dejados para probar a Israel, para saber si los israelitas obedecerían los mandamientos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había dado a sus antepasados por medio de Moisés.
es.R: {{divine_name:El SEÑOR|Yahvé}} usó a estas naciones para probar a Israel. Quería ver si los israelitas obedecerían los mandamientos que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} había dado a sus antepasados por medio de Moisés.

fr.L: Et ils étaient [là] pour éprouver Israël par eux, pour savoir s’ils écouteraient les commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait prescrits à leurs pères par la main de Moïse.
fr.B: Ils furent laissés pour mettre Israël à l’épreuve, pour savoir si les Israélites obéiraient aux commandements {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait donnés à leurs ancêtres par l’intermédiaire de Moïse.
fr.R: {{divine_name:Le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} s’est servi de ces nations pour mettre Israël à l’épreuve. Il voulait voir si les Israélites obéiraient aux commandements qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} avait donnés à leurs ancêtres par Moïse.

vi.L: Và chúng [ở đó] để nhờ chúng thử Y-sơ-ra-ên, để biết họ có nghe theo các điều răn của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} mà {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã truyền cho tổ phụ họ qua tay Môi-se hay không.
vi.B: Các dân ấy được để lại để thử Y-sơ-ra-ên, xem họ có vâng giữ các điều răn {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} đã ban cho tổ tiên họ qua Môi-se hay không.
vi.R: {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dùng các dân tộc này để thử Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ngài muốn xem dân Y-sơ-ra-ên có vâng giữ các điều răn {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã ban cho tổ tiên họ qua Môi-se hay không.

ko.L: 그리고 그들은 그들로 이스라엘을 시험하여, 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세의 손으로 그들의 조상들에게 명령하신 계명들을 듣는지 알려고 [남아] 있었다.
ko.B: 그들이 남아 있었던 것은 이스라엘을 시험하여, 이스라엘 사람들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모세를 통해 그들의 조상들에게 주신 계명들에 순종하는지 알아보시려는 것이었다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 이 민족들을 통해 이스라엘을 시험하셨다. 주님께서는 이스라엘 사람들이, 주님께서 모세를 통해 그들의 조상들에게 주신 명령들에 순종하는지 보려고 하셨다.

pt.L: E eles [estavam ali] para provar Israel por meio deles, para saber se ouviriam os mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha ordenado aos seus pais por meio de Moisés.
pt.B: Elas foram deixadas para provar Israel, para saber se os israelitas obedeceriam aos mandamentos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha dado aos seus antepassados por meio de Moisés.
pt.R: {{divine_name:O SENHOR|Javé}} usou essas nações para pôr Israel à prova. Queria ver se os israelitas obedeceriam aos mandamentos que {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} tinha dado aos seus antepassados por meio de Moisés.

decisions.choice: to test ... to know: to bring into the open what Israel would do
decisions.reason: God tests in order that what is in his people's hearts may be shown, not because he lacks knowledge (Deuteronomy 8:2; 13:4).

decisions.choice: listen to the commandments: obey them; by the hand of Moses: through Moses
decisions.reason: To "hear" a command is to obey it. "By the hand of" someone means through that person as God's agent.

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: "Fathers" here means the earlier generations of the people, women and men; Balanced and Readable say "ancestors".

source.text: וּבְנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל יָשְׁב֖וּ בְּקֶ֣רֶב הַֽכְּנַעֲנִ֑י הַחִתִּ֤י וְהָֽאֱמֹרִי֙ וְהַפְּרִזִּ֔י וְהַחִוִּ֖י וְהַיְבוּסִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: And [the] sons of Israel lived in [the] midst of the Canaanite[s], the Hittite[s], and the Amorite[s], and the Perizzite[s], and the Hivite[s], and the Jebusite[s].

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel lived in the midst of the Canaanites, the Hittites, and the Amorites, and the Perizzites, and the Hivites, and the Jebusites.
en.B: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} lived among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.
en.R: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} lived right among the Canaanites, Hittites, Amorites, Perizzites, Hivites, and Jebusites.

sw.L: Nao wana wa Israeli wakakaa kati ya Wakanaani, Wahiti, na Waamori, na Waperizi, na Wahivi, na Wayebusi.
sw.B: Waisraeli waliishi kati ya Wakanaani, Wahiti, Waamori, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi.
sw.R: Waisraeli waliishi palepale kati ya Wakanaani, Wahiti, Waamori, Waperizi, Wahivi na Wayebusi.

es.L: Y los hijos de Israel habitaron en medio de los cananeos, los hititas, y los amorreos, y los ferezeos, y los heveos, y los jebuseos.
es.B: Los israelitas vivieron entre los cananeos, los hititas, los amorreos, los ferezeos, los heveos y los jebuseos.
es.R: Los israelitas vivieron en medio mismo de los cananeos, los hititas, los amorreos, los ferezeos, los heveos y los jebuseos.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël habitèrent au milieu des Cananéens, des Hittites, et des Amoréens, et des Phéréziens, et des Héviens, et des Jébusiens.
fr.B: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} habitèrent au milieu des Cananéens, des Hittites, des Amoréens, des Phéréziens, des Héviens et des Jébusiens.
fr.R: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont vécu en plein milieu des Cananéens, des Hittites, des Amoréens, des Phéréziens, des Héviens et des Jébusiens.

vi.L: Và con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên sống giữa người Ca-na-an, người Hê-tít, và người A-mô-rít, và người Phê-rê-sít, và người Hê-vít, và người Giê-bu-sít.
vi.B: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sống giữa người Ca-na-an, người Hê-tít, người A-mô-rít, người Phê-rê-sít, người Hê-vít và người Giê-bu-sít.
vi.R: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sống ngay giữa người Ca-na-an, người Hê-tít, người A-mô-rít, người Phê-rê-sít, người Hê-vít và người Giê-bu-sít.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 가나안 사람과 헷 사람과 아모리 사람과 브리스 사람과 히위 사람과 여부스 사람 가운데 살았다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 백성은 가나안 사람, 헷 사람, 아모리 사람, 브리스 사람, 히위 사람, 여부스 사람 가운데 살았다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성은 바로 가나안 사람, 헷 사람, 아모리 사람, 브리스 사람, 히위 사람, 여부스 사람 사이에 섞여 살았다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Israel habitaram no meio dos cananeus, dos hititas, e dos amorreus, e dos ferezeus, e dos heveus, e dos jebuseus.
pt.B: Os israelitas viveram no meio dos cananeus, dos hititas, dos amorreus, dos ferezeus, dos heveus e dos jebuseus.
pt.R: Os israelitas viviam bem no meio dos cananeus, dos hititas, dos amorreus, dos ferezeus, dos heveus e dos jebuseus.

decisions.choice: the six peoples of the land, now living side by side with Israel
decisions.reason: This is the list of the land's peoples from God's promise (Exodus 3:8; 23:23). Israel had been told to make no covenant with them (Deuteronomy 7:1-2), yet now Israel lives in their midst.

decisions.choice: os cananeus, os hititas, os amorreus, os ferezeus, os heveus, os jebuseus
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the peoples of the land (m1) keep the forms Joshua 3:10 and 9:1 use in Portuguese, in the plural at every level.

source.text: וַיִּקְח֨וּ אֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶ֤ם לָהֶם֙ לְנָשִׁ֔ים וְאֶת־בְּנוֹתֵיהֶ֖ם נָתְנ֣וּ לִבְנֵיהֶ֑ם וַיַּעַבְד֖וּ אֶת־אֱלֹהֵיהֶֽם׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And they took their daughters for themselves as wives, and their daughters they gave to their sons, and they served their gods.

en.L: And they took their daughters for themselves as wives, and their [own] daughters they gave to their sons, and they served their gods.
en.B: They took the daughters of these peoples as wives, gave their own daughters to the sons of these peoples, and served their gods.
en.R: Israelite men took women from these nations as wives, and the Israelites gave their own daughters to men from these nations. They also worshiped the gods of these nations.

sw.L: Nao wakawatwaa binti zao kuwa wake zao, na binti zao [wenyewe] wakawapa wana wao, wakaitumikia miungu yao.
sw.B: Waliwaoa binti za watu hao, wakawaoza binti zao wenyewe kwa wana wa watu hao, wakaitumikia miungu yao.
sw.R: Wanaume wa Israeli waliwaoa wanawake wa mataifa hayo, na Waisraeli waliwaoza binti zao wenyewe kwa wanaume wa mataifa hayo. Pia waliiabudu miungu ya mataifa hayo.

es.L: Y tomaron a sus hijas para sí por mujeres, y a sus [propias] hijas las dieron a los hijos de ellos, y sirvieron a sus dioses.
es.B: Tomaron como esposas a las hijas de esos pueblos, dieron sus propias hijas a los hijos de esos pueblos y sirvieron a sus dioses.
es.R: Los hombres israelitas tomaron como esposas a mujeres de esas naciones, y los israelitas dieron a sus propias hijas a hombres de esas naciones. También adoraron a los dioses de esas naciones.

fr.L: Et ils prirent leurs filles pour eux comme femmes, et leurs [propres] filles ils les donnèrent à leurs fils, et ils servirent leurs dieux.
fr.B: Ils prirent pour femmes les filles de ces peuples, donnèrent leurs propres filles aux fils de ces peuples, et servirent leurs dieux.
fr.R: Les hommes d’Israël ont épousé des femmes de ces nations, et les Israélites ont donné leurs propres filles en mariage à des hommes de ces nations. Ils ont aussi adoré les dieux de ces nations.

vi.L: Và họ lấy con gái của chúng làm vợ cho mình, và gả con gái [của mình] cho con trai của chúng, và phụng sự các thần của chúng.
vi.B: Họ cưới con gái của các dân ấy làm vợ, gả con gái mình cho con trai các dân ấy, và phụng sự các thần của họ.
vi.R: Đàn ông Y-sơ-ra-ên cưới phụ nữ của các dân tộc ấy làm vợ, và người Y-sơ-ra-ên gả con gái mình cho đàn ông của các dân tộc ấy. Họ cũng thờ các thần của các dân tộc ấy.

ko.L: 그리고 그들이 그들의 딸들을 자기들의 아내로 맞아들였고, [자기들의] 딸들을 그들의 아들들에게 주었으며, 그들의 신들을 섬겼다.
ko.B: 그들은 이 민족들의 딸들을 아내로 맞아들이고, 자기 딸들을 이 민족들의 아들들에게 주었으며, 그들의 신들을 섬겼다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 남자들은 이 민족들의 여자들을 아내로 맞았다. 그리고 이스라엘 사람들은 자기 딸들을 이 민족들의 남자들에게 시집보냈다. 그들은 이 민족들의 신들도 섬겼다.

pt.L: E tomaram as filhas deles para si como mulheres, e as suas [próprias] filhas deram aos filhos deles, e serviram os deuses deles.
pt.B: Tomaram como esposas as filhas desses povos, deram as suas próprias filhas aos filhos desses povos e serviram os deuses deles.
pt.R: Os homens israelitas se casaram com mulheres dessas nações, e os israelitas deram as suas próprias filhas a homens dessas nações. Também adoraram os deuses dessas nações.

decisions.choice: marriage with the peoples of the land, leading to the worship of their gods
decisions.reason: Deuteronomy 7:3-4 forbade exactly this, warning that such marriages would turn Israel's children away to serve other gods. The verse shows that warning coming true.

decisions.choice: served: worshiped
decisions.reason: To serve a god is to worship it and live under its claim.

decisions.choice: these peoples / these nations
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says "their" for both groups. Balanced and Readable name the other peoples so that it is clear whose daughters went where.

source.text: וַיַּעֲשׂ֨וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל אֶת־הָרַע֙ בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה וַֽיִּשְׁכְּח֖וּ אֶת־יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹֽהֵיהֶ֑ם וַיַּעַבְד֥וּ אֶת־הַבְּעָלִ֖ים וְאֶת־הָאֲשֵׁרֽוֹת׃

records.literal_gloss: And did [the] sons of Israel the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, and forgot Yahweh their God, and served the Baals and the Asherahs.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and they forgot {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God and served the Baals and the Asherahs.
en.B: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. They forgot {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God, and they served the Baals and the Asherahs.
en.R: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil. They forgot {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} their God and worshiped the Baals and the goddesses called the Asherahs.

sw.L: Nao wana wa Israeli wakafanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, wakamsahau {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, wakawatumikia Mabaali na Maashera.
sw.B: Waisraeli walifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Walimsahau {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, wakawatumikia Mabaali na Maashera.
sw.R: Waisraeli walifanya yale ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema ni maovu. Walimsahau {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Mungu wao, wakawaabudu Mabaali na miungu ya kike iitwayo Maashera.

es.L: Y los hijos de Israel hicieron lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y se olvidaron {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios, y sirvieron a los baales y a las aserás.
es.B: Los israelitas hicieron lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Se olvidaron {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios y sirvieron a los baales y a las aserás.
es.R: Los israelitas hicieron lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho que era malo. Se olvidaron {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} su Dios y adoraron a los baales y a las diosas llamadas aserás.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël firent le mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et ils oublièrent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu, et ils servirent les Baals et les Ashéras.
fr.B: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} firent ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Ils oublièrent {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu et servirent les Baals et les Ashéras.
fr.R: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclarait mauvais. Ils ont oublié {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur Dieu et ont adoré les Baals et les déesses qu’on appelle les Ashéras.

vi.L: Và con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và họ quên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ, và phụng sự các Ba-anh và các A-sê-ra.
vi.B: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Họ quên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ mà phụng sự các thần Ba-anh và các nữ thần A-sê-ra.
vi.R: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác. Họ quên {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} Đức Chúa Trời của họ mà thờ các thần Ba-anh và các nữ thần gọi là A-sê-ra.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보시기에 악한 일을 하였고, 그들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 잊어버리고 바알들과 아세라들을 섬겼다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보시기에 악한 일을 하였다. 그들은 자기들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 잊어버리고 바알들과 아세라들을 섬겼다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성은 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 하였다. 그들은 자기들의 하나님 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}를 잊어버리고, 바알들과 아세라라고 불리는 여신들을 섬겼다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Israel fizeram o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e esqueceram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, e serviram os baalins e as aserás.
pt.B: Os israelitas fizeram o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Esqueceram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, e serviram os baalins e as aserás.
pt.R: Os israelitas fizeram o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava mau. Esqueceram {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}}, o seu Deus, e adoraram os baalins e as deusas chamadas aserás.

decisions.choice: did the evil in the eyes of Yahweh: the formula that opens each round of the book's cycle
decisions.reason: The same words begin the story of each oppression (2:11; 3:12; 4:1; 6:1). What is evil is measured by what the LORD sees as evil.

decisions.choice: forgot: abandoned, ceased to be loyal to
decisions.reason: Forgetting God is not a lapse of memory but turning from him and his covenant (Deuteronomy 8:11-19).

decisions.choice: the Baals and the Asherahs: Canaanite gods and goddesses in their many local forms
decisions.reason: Baal was the storm god of Canaan, worshiped at many local shrines, so the plural speaks of these many forms. Asherah was a goddess, and the same word names the wooden poles set up for her (Exodus 34:13). Paired here with the Baals, the plural most likely means the goddess in her local forms or images. Judges 2:13 pairs Baal with the Ashtaroth instead.

decisions.choice: the Asherahs
decisions.reason: Literal and Balanced keep the name as a plural, since it stands beside the Baals as a group of deities; "Asherah poles" is kept for places where the objects are meant. Readable explains both names.

decisions.choice: "las aserás"
decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges, as the terms note for these books sets: the goddesses and their wooden poles are "las aserás", a common plural like "los baales" and "las astartés"; Readable says they were goddesses, as the English Readable does (m3).

decisions.choice: "바알들과 아세라들" for the Baals and the Asherahs; Readable adds that the Asherahs were goddesses
decisions.reason: The names as the terms of this translation set for Judges; Readable explains them as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "các A-sê-ra" (L); "các nữ thần A-sê-ra" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's form; here the word names the goddess in her many local forms (m3), so Balanced and Readable say "goddesses" rather than the wooden poles.

decisions.choice: as aserás (L, B); as deusas chamadas aserás (R); a Aserá, os postes de Aserá
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the goddess is "Aserá" and the wooden poles set up for her "os postes de Aserá", as Exodus 34:13 and Deuteronomy 16:21 have them in Portuguese, following the English level by level (6:25-30). Here the plural stands beside the baalins as a group of deities (m3), so it is "as aserás", lower case like "os baalins".

source.text: וַיִּֽחַר־אַ֤ף יְהוָה֙ בְּיִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַֽיִּמְכְּרֵ֗ם בְּיַד֙ כּוּשַׁ֣ן רִשְׁעָתַ֔יִם מֶ֖לֶךְ אֲרַ֣ם נַהֲרָ֑יִם וַיַּעַבְד֧וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל אֶת־כּוּשַׁ֥ן רִשְׁעָתַ֖יִם שְׁמֹנֶ֥ה שָׁנִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And burned [the] anger of Yahweh against Israel, and he sold them into [the] hand of Cushan-rishathaim king of Aram-naharaim, and served [the] sons of Israel Cushan-rishathaim eight years.

en.L: And the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} burned against Israel, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sold them into [the] hand of Cushan-rishathaim king of Aram-naharaim, and the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel served Cushan-rishathaim eight years.
en.B: So the anger of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} blazed against Israel, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} sold them into the power of Cushan-rishathaim king of Aram-naharaim. The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} served Cushan-rishathaim for eight years.
en.R: This made {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} very angry with Israel. So {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} handed them over to Cushan-rishathaim, the king of Aram-naharaim, a land far to the northeast. The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} had to serve him for eight years.

sw.L: Na hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikawaka juu ya Israeli, akawauza mkononi mwa Kushan-rishathaimu mfalme wa Aramu-naharaimu, nao wana wa Israeli wakamtumikia Kushan-rishathaimu miaka minane.
sw.B: Basi hasira ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ikawaka dhidi ya Israeli, naye akawauza mikononi mwa Kushan-rishathaimu mfalme wa Aramu-naharaimu. Waisraeli walimtumikia Kushan-rishathaimu kwa miaka minane.
sw.R: Jambo hilo lilimkasirisha {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} sana juu ya Israeli. Kwa hiyo aliwatia mikononi mwa Kushan-rishathaimu, mfalme wa Aramu-naharaimu, nchi iliyokuwa mbali upande wa kaskazini-mashariki. Waisraeli walilazimika kumtumikia kwa miaka minane.

es.L: Y se encendió la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} contra Israel, y los vendió en mano de Cusán-risataim, rey de Aram-naharaim; y los hijos de Israel sirvieron a Cusán-risataim ocho años.
es.B: Entonces la ira {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} se encendió contra Israel, y los vendió en poder de Cusán-risataim, rey de Aram-naharaim. Los israelitas sirvieron a Cusán-risataim durante ocho años.
es.R: Esto hizo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} se enojara mucho con Israel. Así que los entregó a Cusán-risataim, el rey de Aram-naharaim, una tierra muy lejana, al noreste. Los israelitas tuvieron que servirle durante ocho años.

fr.L: Et la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’enflamma contre Israël, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les vendit dans la main de Koushân-Rishataïm, roi d’Aram-Naharaïm ; et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël servirent Koushân-Rishataïm huit ans.
fr.B: Alors la colère {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} s’enflamma contre Israël, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les vendit au pouvoir de Koushân-Rishataïm, roi d’Aram-Naharaïm. Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} furent asservis à Koushân-Rishataïm pendant huit ans.
fr.R: Cela a mis {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} très en colère contre Israël. Alors {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} les a livrés à Koushân-Rishataïm, le roi d’Aram-Naharaïm, un pays lointain au nord-est. Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont dû le servir pendant huit ans.

vi.L: Và cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi phừng lên cùng Y-sơ-ra-ên, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bán họ vào tay Cu-san-Ri-sa-tha-im, vua A-ram-Na-ha-ra-im, và con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên phục dịch Cu-san-Ri-sa-tha-im tám năm.
vi.B: Vậy cơn giận của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} nổi phừng lên cùng Y-sơ-ra-ên, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bán họ vào tay Cu-san-Ri-sa-tha-im, vua A-ram-Na-ha-ra-im. Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên phục dịch Cu-san-Ri-sa-tha-im tám năm.
vi.R: Việc này làm {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} rất giận Y-sơ-ra-ên. Vì vậy {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} giao họ cho Cu-san-Ri-sa-tha-im, vua A-ram-Na-ha-ra-im, một xứ xa về phía đông bắc. Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên phải phục dịch vua ấy tám năm.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 진노가 이스라엘에게 불타올라, 그분께서 그들을 아람나하라임 왕 구산리사다임의 손에 파셨다. 그래서 이스라엘 자손이 구산리사다임을 팔 년 동안 섬겼다.
ko.B: 그래서 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘에게 크게 진노하셔서, 그들을 아람나하라임 왕 구산리사다임의 손에 파셨다. 이스라엘 백성은 팔 년 동안 구산리사다임을 섬겼다.
ko.R: 이 일로 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘에게 몹시 화가 나셨다. 그래서 주님께서는 그들을 구산리사다임에게 넘기셨다. 그는 멀리 북동쪽에 있는 땅 아람나하라임의 왕이었다. 이스라엘 백성은 팔 년 동안 그를 섬겨야 했다.

pt.L: E a ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} se acendeu contra Israel, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os vendeu na mão de Cusã-Risataim, rei de Arã-Naaraim; e os filhos de Israel serviram Cusã-Risataim oito anos.
pt.B: Então a ira {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} se inflamou contra Israel, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os vendeu ao poder de Cusã-Risataim, rei de Arã-Naaraim. Os israelitas serviram Cusã-Risataim por oito anos.
pt.R: Isso deixou {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} muito irado com Israel. Por isso {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} os entregou a Cusã-Risataim, o rei de Arã-Naaraim, uma terra muito distante, no nordeste. Os israelitas tiveram de servi-lo por oito anos.

decisions.choice: the anger of Yahweh burned: God was very angry
decisions.reason: Anger is pictured as a fire that flares up, as in 2:14 and 2:20.

decisions.choice: sold them into the hand of: handed them over to the power of
decisions.reason: As an owner sells a slave to a new master, God gives his people over to a foreign ruler (2:14; 4:2; 10:7). "Hand" stands for power.

decisions.choice: Cushan-rishathaim, king of Aram-naharaim: a ruler from the upper Euphrates
decisions.reason: Aram-naharaim, "Aram of the two rivers", is the land of the upper Euphrates in the far north, where Abraham's family lived (Genesis 24:10). The king is not known from any other source. His name can be heard as "Cushan of double wickedness", and the story may use it as a mocking name.

decisions.choice: a land far to the northeast
decisions.reason: Readable says where Aram-naharaim was, so the reader knows the oppressor came from far away.

decisions.choice: sold them into the power of / handed them over to
decisions.reason: Balanced keeps the picture of selling and says "power" for "hand"; Readable says plainly that God handed them over. This wording is used for the phrase throughout Judges.

decisions.choice: "phục dịch" for Israel serving a foreign king
decisions.reason: "phụng sự" is kept for the service of a god (2:7); serving an overlord as his subjects is "phục dịch", so the two kinds of service stay apart in Vietnamese.

decisions.choice: Cusã-Risataim, rei de Arã-Naaraim
decisions.reason: The Brazilian forms of the names (m3), "Arã-Naaraim" as Genesis 24:10 has it in Portuguese. Readable says where the land was, as the English does, rather than giving the Greek name "Mesopotâmia".

source.text: וַיִּזְעֲק֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶל־יְהוָ֔ה וַיָּ֨קֶם יְהוָ֥ה מוֹשִׁ֛יעַ לִבְנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל וַיּֽוֹשִׁיעֵ֑ם אֵ֚ת עָתְנִיאֵ֣ל בֶּן־קְנַ֔ז אֲחִ֥י כָלֵ֖ב הַקָּטֹ֥ן מִמֶּֽנּוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: And cried out [the] sons of Israel to Yahweh, and raised up Yahweh a deliverer for [the] sons of Israel, and he delivered them: Othniel son of Kenaz, [the] brother of Caleb, the younger than he.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} raised up a deliverer for the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel, and he delivered them: Othniel son of Kenaz, the brother of Caleb, younger than he.
en.B: Then the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} raised up a deliverer for them, who rescued them: Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.
en.R: When the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help, {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave them someone to rescue them. It was Othniel son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother.

sw.L: Nao wana wa Israeli wakamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawainulia wana wa Israeli mwokozi, naye akawaokoa: Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi, ndugu ya Kalebu, mdogo kuliko yeye.
sw.B: Kisha Waisraeli walimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawainulia mwokozi, aliyewaokoa: Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi, ndugu mdogo wa Kalebu.
sw.R: Waisraeli walipomlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awasaidie, aliwapa mtu wa kuwaokoa. Huyo alikuwa Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi, ndugu mdogo wa Kalebu.

es.L: Y clamaron los hijos de Israel {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} levantó un libertador para los hijos de Israel, y los libró: Otoniel hijo de Quenaz, hermano de Caleb, menor que él.
es.B: Entonces los israelitas clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les levantó un libertador que los libró: Otoniel hijo de Quenaz, el hermano menor de Caleb.
es.R: Cuando los israelitas clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} pidiendo ayuda, {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dio a alguien que los rescatara. Fue Otoniel hijo de Quenaz, el hermano menor de Caleb.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël crièrent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} suscita un libérateur pour les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël, et il les délivra : Otniel, fils de Kenaz, frère de Caleb, plus jeune que lui.
fr.B: Alors les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} crièrent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur suscita un libérateur qui les délivra : Otniel, fils de Kenaz, le frère cadet de Caleb.
fr.R: Quand les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont appelé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au secours, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a donné quelqu’un pour les délivrer. C’était Otniel, fils de Kenaz, le frère plus jeune de Caleb.

vi.L: Và con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dấy lên một người giải cứu cho con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên, và người giải cứu họ: Ốt-ni-ên con trai Kê-na, em của Ca-lép, nhỏ hơn ông.
vi.B: Bấy giờ dân Y-sơ-ra-ên kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dấy lên cho họ một người giải cứu, là người đã cứu họ: Ốt-ni-ên con trai Kê-na, em của Ca-lép.
vi.R: Khi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ, {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho họ một người để giải cứu họ. Người ấy là Ốt-ni-ên con trai Kê-na, em của Ca-lép.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖자, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 이스라엘 자손을 위하여 구원자를 일으키셨고, 그가 그들을 구원하였다. 그는 갈렙의 아우, 그보다 어린 그나스의 아들 옷니엘이었다.
ko.B: 그때 이스라엘 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖었다. 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 위하여 구원자를 세우셨고, 그가 그들을 구해 내었다. 그는 갈렙의 아우인 그나스의 아들 옷니엘이었다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성이 도와 달라고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖자, 주님께서 그들을 구해 낼 사람을 주셨다. 그는 갈렙의 아우인 그나스의 아들 옷니엘이었다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Israel clamaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} levantou um libertador para os filhos de Israel, e ele os salvou: Otniel, filho de Quenaz, irmão de Calebe, mais novo do que ele.
pt.B: Então os israelitas clamaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} levantou para eles um libertador, que os livrou: Otniel, filho de Quenaz, irmão mais novo de Calebe.
pt.R: Quando os israelitas clamaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} pedindo ajuda, {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes deu alguém para livrá-los. Foi Otniel, filho de Quenaz, irmão mais novo de Calebe.

decisions.choice: a deliverer: one who rescues from enemies
decisions.reason: The noun and the verb come from the same root, "save, rescue". This is the book's first description of the judges: people God raises to rescue Israel from oppressors (2:16, 18).

decisions.choice: younger than he: Othniel was Caleb's younger brother
alternatives: the son of Kenaz, Caleb's younger brother (Othniel as Caleb's nephew)
decisions.reason: The phrase most naturally describes Othniel as the younger brother. It could also be read as making Kenaz Caleb's younger brother, so that Othniel was Caleb's nephew. 1:13 and Joshua 15:17 use the same wording.

decisions.choice: Othniel: the hero who took Debir
decisions.reason: Othniel has already appeared in 1:12-13, where he captured Debir and married Caleb's daughter Achsah. The first judge comes from the family of Caleb, who followed the LORD fully (Numbers 14:24).

decisions.choice: for help
decisions.reason: Crying out to God here is a call for rescue. Readable says so.

decisions.choice: "un libérateur" for the noun; "délivrer" for the verb
decisions.reason: For Judges 1-10: the Hebrew noun and verb are from the root "save". French "sauveur" today points to Christ and to salvation from sin; "libérateur" and "délivrer" say plainly that these men rescued Israel from its enemies, as the English "deliverer" and "rescued" do.

decisions.choice: "người giải cứu"
decisions.reason: One who rescues from enemies (m1); the same word is kept for each deliverer of the book.

decisions.choice: clamaram ao SENHOR; levantou um libertador (L, B); lhes deu alguém para livrá-los (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the cycle keeps one wording at each level. Israel "clamou ao SENHOR", the word for a cry for help Exodus 2:23 uses in Portuguese, and the LORD "levantou um libertador" (m1), "libertador" because "salvador" would suggest the Christian title; Readable says it as the English Readable does. The other steps: 2:11 (the evil), 2:14 and 3:8 (sold into the hand of), 3:11 (the rest).

source.text: וַתְּהִ֨י עָלָ֥יו רֽוּחַ־יְהוָה֮ וַיִּשְׁפֹּ֣ט אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵל֒ וַיֵּצֵא֙ לַמִּלְחָמָ֔ה וַיִּתֵּ֤ן יְהוָה֙ בְּיָד֔וֹ אֶת־כּוּשַׁ֥ן רִשְׁעָתַ֖יִם מֶ֣לֶךְ אֲרָ֑ם וַתָּ֣עָז יָד֔וֹ עַ֖ל כּוּשַׁ֥ן רִשְׁעָתָֽיִם׃

records.literal_gloss: And was on him [the] Spirit of Yahweh, and he judged Israel, and he went out to war, and gave Yahweh into his hand Cushan-rishathaim king of Aram, and was strong his hand over Cushan-rishathaim.

en.L: And the Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} was on him, and he judged Israel, and he went out to war, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave Cushan-rishathaim king of Aram into his hand, and his hand was strong over Cushan-rishathaim.
en.B: The Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came on him, and he judged Israel. He went out to war, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave Cushan-rishathaim king of Aram into his power, so that he overpowered Cushan-rishathaim.
en.R: The Spirit of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} came on Othniel, and he led Israel. He went out to fight, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} gave him victory over Cushan-rishathaim, the king of Aram. Othniel completely defeated him.

sw.L: Naye Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawa juu yake, naye akawaamua Israeli, akatoka kwenda vitani, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamtia Kushan-rishathaimu mfalme wa Aramu mkononi mwake, na mkono wake ukawa na nguvu juu ya Kushan-rishathaimu.
sw.B: Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimjia, naye akawaamua Israeli. Alitoka kwenda vitani, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamtia Kushan-rishathaimu mfalme wa Aramu mikononi mwake, hata akamshinda Kushan-rishathaimu.
sw.R: Roho wa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimjia Othnieli, naye akawaongoza Israeli. Alitoka kwenda kupigana, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akampa ushindi juu ya Kushan-rishathaimu, mfalme wa Aramu. Othnieli alimshinda kabisa.

es.L: Y el Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} estuvo sobre él, y juzgó a Israel, y salió a la guerra, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} entregó en su mano a Cusán-risataim, rey de Aram, y su mano prevaleció sobre Cusán-risataim.
es.B: El Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino sobre él, y juzgó a Israel. Salió a la guerra, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} entregó en su poder a Cusán-risataim, rey de Aram, de modo que lo venció.
es.R: El Espíritu {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}} vino sobre Otoniel, y él dirigió a Israel. Salió a pelear, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} le dio la victoria sobre Cusán-risataim, el rey de Aram. Otoniel lo derrotó por completo.

fr.L: Et l’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} fut sur lui, et il jugea Israël, et il sortit pour la guerre, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} livra dans sa main Koushân-Rishataïm, roi d’Aram, et sa main fut forte contre Koushân-Rishataïm.
fr.B: L’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} vint sur lui, et il jugea Israël. Il partit en guerre, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} livra en son pouvoir Koushân-Rishataïm, roi d’Aram, si bien qu’il l’emporta sur Koushân-Rishataïm.
fr.R: L’Esprit {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}} est venu sur Otniel, et il a dirigé Israël. Il est parti au combat, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} lui a donné la victoire sur Koushân-Rishataïm, le roi d’Aram. Otniel l’a complètement vaincu.

vi.L: Và Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ở trên người, và người xét xử Y-sơ-ra-ên, và người ra trận, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} phó Cu-san-Ri-sa-tha-im, vua A-ram, vào tay người, và tay người mạnh hơn Cu-san-Ri-sa-tha-im.
vi.B: Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngự trên người, và người xét xử Y-sơ-ra-ên. Người ra trận, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giao Cu-san-Ri-sa-tha-im, vua A-ram, vào tay người, nên người thắng Cu-san-Ri-sa-tha-im.
vi.R: Thần Linh của {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} ngự trên Ốt-ni-ên, và ông lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên. Ông ra trận, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho ông chiến thắng Cu-san-Ri-sa-tha-im, vua A-ram. Ốt-ni-ên đánh bại vua ấy hoàn toàn.

ko.L: 그리고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 그에게 임하였고, 그가 이스라엘을 다스렸다. 그가 전쟁하러 나가자, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 아람 왕 구산리사다임을 그의 손에 주셨고, 그의 손이 구산리사다임을 이겼다.
ko.B: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 그에게 임하여, 그가 이스라엘을 다스렸다. 그가 전쟁하러 나가자, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 아람 왕 구산리사다임을 그의 손에 넘겨주셨다. 그래서 그는 구산리사다임을 이겼다.
ko.R: {{divine_name:주|야훼}}의 영이 옷니엘에게 임하였고, 그는 이스라엘을 이끌었다. 그가 싸우러 나가자, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 아람 왕 구산리사다임을 이기게 해 주셨다. 옷니엘은 그를 완전히 무찔렀다.

pt.L: E o Espírito {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} esteve sobre ele, e ele julgou Israel, e saiu à guerra, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} entregou na sua mão Cusã-Risataim, rei de Arã, e a sua mão prevaleceu sobre Cusã-Risataim.
pt.B: O Espírito {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} veio sobre ele, e ele julgou Israel. Saiu para a guerra, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} entregou Cusã-Risataim, rei de Arã, ao seu poder, e ele venceu Cusã-Risataim.
pt.R: O Espírito {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}} veio sobre Otniel, e ele liderou Israel. Saiu para lutar, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhe deu a vitória sobre Cusã-Risataim, o rei de Arã. Otniel derrotou o rei completamente.

decisions.choice: the Spirit of Yahweh came on him: God gave him power for his task
decisions.reason: This is the first time in the book that the Spirit comes on a judge. The Spirit gives the strength and leadership needed for rescue (6:34; 11:29; 14:6).

decisions.choice: judged Israel: led and governed Israel
decisions.reason: As at 2:16, a judge is a leader raised to rescue Israel and govern it, more than a judge in a court.

decisions.choice: gave into his hand ... his hand was strong over: God gave him the victory
decisions.reason: "Hand" stands for power. The LORD gives the enemy into Othniel's power, and so Othniel prevails.

decisions.choice: led Israel
decisions.reason: Readable says "led" for the verb "judge" throughout Judges, because "judge" suggests a court.

decisions.choice: Othniel
decisions.reason: Readable names Othniel where the Hebrew says "him" and "his".

decisions.choice: "Roho wa BWANA alimjia" (B, R; Literal "akawa juu yake"); "akawaamua Israeli" (L, B) and "akawaongoza Israeli" (R)
decisions.reason: The terms note sets "Roho wa BWANA alimjia" for the Spirit coming on a judge, and "aliwaamua Israeli" for the verb that goes with "mwamuzi". Literal follows the Hebrew "was on him"; Readable says "led Israel", as the English Readable does.

decisions.choice: "el Espíritu del SEÑOR vino sobre él" (B, R; "estuvo sobre él" at L); "juzgó a Israel" (L, B), "dirigió a Israel" (R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges, as the terms note for these books sets: "Espíritu" keeps its capital, as the English "Spirit" does, for the LORD's own Spirit giving the judge power for his task (m1). The verb "judge" is "juzgar" at Literal and Balanced and "dirigir" at Readable, since it means to lead and govern (m2).

decisions.choice: "l'Esprit du SEIGNEUR vint sur" (B, R), with a capital E
decisions.reason: For Judges 1-10, as the terms note sets: the Spirit is God's own Spirit giving power for the task, and French writes "l'Esprit" with a capital, as the English writes "Spirit".

decisions.choice: "il a dirigé Israël" (R) for "he judged Israel"; "il jugea Israël" (L, B)
alternatives: "il a été juge en Israël" at Readable
decisions.reason: As the terms note sets for the verb *shafat*: Literal and Balanced keep "juger", Readable says what the judge did, leading and governing the people, as the English Readable "led Israel" does.

decisions.choice: "Thần Linh của CHÚA"; "ở trên" (L), "ngự trên" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's form, with a capital as in Genesis 1:2 and Psalm 139:7: God gave him power for his task (m1).

decisions.choice: "xét xử Y-sơ-ra-ên" (L, B); "lãnh đạo Y-sơ-ra-ên" (R)
decisions.reason: As the decision at 2:16: the judge led and governed Israel (m2).

decisions.choice: "이스라엘을 다스렸다" (L, B) and "이스라엘을 이끌었다" (R) for *shafat* (judged Israel); "주의 영이 ... 임하였다" for the Spirit coming on him
decisions.reason: As the terms of this translation set for Judges: the judges led and governed Israel (m2), so Korean says "governed" at Literal and Balanced and "led" at Readable. "임하였다" is the Korean word for God's Spirit coming on someone.

decisions.choice: julgou Israel (L, B); liderou Israel (R)
decisions.reason: As set at 2:16 for the whole book: the verb that goes with "juiz" is "julgar" at Literal and Balanced, and "liderar" at Readable, as the English Readable says "led" (m2). "O Espírito do SENHOR" takes a capital, as in docs/portuguese-style.md, section 5.

source.text: וַתִּשְׁקֹ֥ט הָאָ֖רֶץ אַרְבָּעִ֣ים שָׁנָ֑ה וַיָּ֖מָת עָתְנִיאֵ֥ל בֶּן־קְנַֽז׃פ

records.literal_gloss: And was quiet the land forty years, and died Othniel son of Kenaz.

en.L: And the land was quiet forty years. And Othniel son of Kenaz died.
en.B: Then the land had peace for forty years, and Othniel son of Kenaz died.
en.R: After that the land had peace for forty years. Then Othniel son of Kenaz died.

sw.L: Nayo nchi ikastarehe miaka arobaini. Naye Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi akafa.
sw.B: Kisha nchi ilikuwa na amani kwa miaka arobaini, naye Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi akafa.
sw.R: Baada ya hapo nchi ilikuwa na amani kwa miaka arobaini. Kisha Othnieli mwana wa Kenazi akafa.

es.L: Y la tierra tuvo reposo cuarenta años. Y murió Otoniel hijo de Quenaz.
es.B: Entonces la tierra tuvo paz durante cuarenta años, y murió Otoniel hijo de Quenaz.
es.R: Después de eso la tierra tuvo paz durante cuarenta años. Luego murió Otoniel hijo de Quenaz.

fr.L: Et le pays fut en repos quarante ans. Et Otniel, fils de Kenaz, mourut.
fr.B: Puis le pays eut la paix pendant quarante ans, et Otniel, fils de Kenaz, mourut.
fr.R: Après cela, le pays a eu la paix pendant quarante ans. Puis Otniel, fils de Kenaz, est mort.

vi.L: Và xứ được yên ổn bốn mươi năm. Và Ốt-ni-ên con trai Kê-na qua đời.
vi.B: Sau đó xứ được bình an trong bốn mươi năm, rồi Ốt-ni-ên con trai Kê-na qua đời.
vi.R: Sau đó xứ được bình an trong bốn mươi năm. Rồi Ốt-ni-ên con trai Kê-na qua đời.

ko.L: 그리고 그 땅이 사십 년 동안 평온하였다. 그리고 그나스의 아들 옷니엘이 죽었다.
ko.B: 그 뒤로 그 땅이 사십 년 동안 평온하였다. 그리고 그나스의 아들 옷니엘이 죽었다.
ko.R: 그 뒤로 그 땅은 사십 년 동안 평온하였다. 그러다가 그나스의 아들 옷니엘이 죽었다.

pt.L: E a terra ficou em sossego quarenta anos. E Otniel, filho de Quenaz, morreu.
pt.B: Então a terra teve descanso por quarenta anos, e Otniel, filho de Quenaz, morreu.
pt.R: Depois disso, a terra teve descanso por quarenta anos. Então Otniel, filho de Quenaz, morreu.

decisions.choice: the land was quiet: it was at rest, free from war and oppression
decisions.reason: The verb means to be quiet or undisturbed. It closes each round of rescue (3:30; 5:31; 8:28).

decisions.choice: forty years: a full generation
decisions.reason: Forty is the usual span of a generation in the Bible (Numbers 14:33), and the book's periods of rest come in forties and eighties (5:31; 8:28; 3:30).

decisions.choice: had peace
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say "the land had peace" for this formula throughout Judges; Literal keeps "was quiet".

decisions.choice: "nchi ikastarehe" (L); "nchi ilikuwa na amani" (B, R), through the book
decisions.reason: The Hebrew says the land "was quiet", at rest from war. Literal keeps that picture with "ikastarehe"; Balanced and Readable say it had peace, as the terms note and the English do.

decisions.choice: "la tierra tuvo reposo" (L); "la tierra tuvo paz" (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole of Judges, as the terms note for these books sets: the closing formula of each round means the land was at rest, free from war and oppression (m1). Literal keeps the picture of rest; Balanced and Readable say "paz", as the English says "had peace".

decisions.choice: "le pays fut en repos" (L); "le pays eut la paix" (B, R)
decisions.reason: For Judges 1-10, as the terms note sets: the Hebrew verb means to be quiet, at rest from war and oppression. Literal says "fut en repos"; Balanced and Readable say what that rest was, peace, as the English does.

decisions.choice: "xứ được yên ổn" (L); "xứ được bình an" (B, R)
decisions.reason: The terms note's wording for this refrain, kept each time it returns: the land was at rest, free from war (m1).

decisions.choice: "그 땅이 평온하였다" at every level
alternatives: "평화를 누렸다" (had peace) at Balanced and Readable, as the English
decisions.reason: As the terms of this translation set for this refrain, so that it reads the same each time it returns. "평온" already says both quiet and peace.

decisions.choice: ficou em sossego (L); teve descanso (B, R)
decisions.reason: For the whole book (3:30; 5:31; 8:28): the sentence that closes each rescue (m1) says the land was undisturbed. Literal says "ficou em sossego", close to "was quiet"; Balanced and Readable say "a terra teve descanso", the Portuguese way of saying a land was free of war, where the English says "had peace".

source.text: וַיֹּסִ֨פוּ֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל לַעֲשׂ֥וֹת הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֣י יְהוָ֑ה וַיְחַזֵּ֨ק יְהוָ֜ה אֶת־עֶגְל֤וֹן מֶֽלֶךְ־מוֹאָב֙ עַל־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל עַ֛ל כִּֽי־עָשׂ֥וּ אֶת־הָרַ֖ע בְּעֵינֵ֥י יְהוָֽה׃

records.literal_gloss: And again did [the] sons of Israel the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh, and strengthened Yahweh Eglon king of Moab against Israel, because they had done the evil in [the] eyes of Yahweh.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel again did the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} strengthened Eglon king of Moab against Israel, because they had done the evil in [the] eyes of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.B: Once again the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} did what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}. So {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made Eglon king of Moab strong against Israel, because they had done what was evil in the sight of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}.
en.R: Once again the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} did what {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} said was evil. Because of this, {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} made Eglon king of Moab strong enough to attack Israel.

sw.L: Nao wana wa Israeli wakafanya tena maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamtia nguvu Egloni mfalme wa Moabu juu ya Israeli, kwa sababu walikuwa wamefanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.B: Kwa mara nyingine Waisraeli walifanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}. Basi {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akamtia nguvu Egloni mfalme wa Moabu dhidi ya Israeli, kwa sababu walikuwa wamefanya maovu machoni pa {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}.
sw.R: Kwa mara nyingine Waisraeli walifanya yale ambayo {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alisema ni maovu. Kwa sababu hiyo, {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} alimpa Egloni mfalme wa Moabu nguvu ya kuwashambulia Israeli.

es.L: Y volvieron los hijos de Israel a hacer lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} fortaleció a Eglón, rey de Moab, contra Israel, porque habían hecho lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.B: Una vez más los israelitas hicieron lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}. Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo que Eglón, rey de Moab, se fortaleciera contra Israel, porque habían hecho lo malo a los ojos {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}.
es.R: Una vez más los israelitas hicieron lo que {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} había dicho que era malo. Por eso {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} hizo que Eglón, rey de Moab, fuera lo bastante fuerte para atacar a Israel.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël firent encore le mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} fortifia Églon, roi de Moab, contre Israël, parce qu’ils avaient fait le mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.B: Une fois encore, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} firent ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}. Alors {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} rendit Églon, roi de Moab, puissant contre Israël, parce qu’ils avaient fait ce qui est mal aux yeux {{divine_name:du SEIGNEUR|de Yahvé}}.
fr.R: Une fois encore, les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont fait ce que {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} déclarait mauvais. À cause de cela, {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} a rendu Églon, roi de Moab, assez fort pour attaquer Israël.

vi.L: Và con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên lại làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho Éc-lôn, vua Mô-áp, mạnh lên chống lại Y-sơ-ra-ên, vì họ đã làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.B: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên lại làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}. Vì vậy {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho Éc-lôn, vua Mô-áp, mạnh lên chống lại Y-sơ-ra-ên, vì họ đã làm điều ác trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}.
vi.R: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên lại làm điều {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} cho là ác. Vì thế {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} làm cho Éc-lôn, vua Mô-áp, đủ mạnh để tấn công Y-sơ-ra-ên.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 다시 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보시기에 악한 일을 하였다. 그러자 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 모압 왕 에글론을 강하게 하셔서 이스라엘을 대적하게 하셨다. 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보시기에 악한 일을 하였기 때문이다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 백성은 또다시 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보시기에 악한 일을 하였다. 그들이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 보시기에 악한 일을 하였으므로, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 모압 왕 에글론을 강하게 하셔서 이스라엘을 치게 하셨다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성은 또다시 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 악하다고 하신 일을 하였다. 이 때문에 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서는 모압 왕 에글론을 강하게 하셔서 이스라엘을 공격하게 하셨다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Israel voltaram a fazer o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} fortaleceu Eglom, rei de Moabe, contra Israel, porque tinham feito o mal aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.B: Mais uma vez os israelitas fizeram o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}. Então {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu força a Eglom, rei de Moabe, contra Israel, porque eles tinham feito o que era mau aos olhos {{divine_name:do SENHOR|de Javé}}.
pt.R: Mais uma vez os israelitas fizeram o que {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} considerava mau. Por causa disso, {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} deu forças a Eglom, rei de Moabe, para atacar Israel.

decisions.choice: again: a new round of the cycle begins
decisions.reason: The verb means "to do again". After the rest of verse 11, Israel returns to the same evil as in verse 7, and the pattern starts over (4:1; 10:6; 13:1).

decisions.choice: Yahweh strengthened Eglon: God gave a foreign king power to discipline Israel
decisions.reason: The enemy's strength comes from the LORD, who uses Moab to punish his people's unfaithfulness, as 2:14-15 says. The verse names the reason twice.

decisions.choice: Eglon king of Moab: ruler of the land east of the Dead Sea
decisions.reason: Moab lay east of the Dead Sea; its people traced their descent from Lot (Genesis 19:37). Moab had tried to stop Israel on its way into the land (Numbers 22-24).

decisions.choice: Because of this
decisions.reason: Readable states the reason once, at the start of the second sentence, instead of repeating the whole phrase.

decisions.choice: Eglom, rei de Moabe
decisions.reason: For the whole book: the king's name is spelled like the town in Joshua 10:3, "Eglom", with the Brazilian ending; "Moabe" as in Numbers and Joshua.

source.text: וַיֶּאֱסֹ֣ף אֵלָ֔יו אֶת־בְּנֵ֥י עַמּ֖וֹן וַעֲמָלֵ֑ק וַיֵּ֗לֶךְ וַיַּךְ֙ אֶת־יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וַיִּֽירְשׁ֖וּ אֶת־עִ֥יר הַתְּמָרִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: And he gathered to himself [the] sons of Ammon and Amalek, and he went and struck Israel, and they took possession of [the] city of the palms.

en.L: And he gathered to himself the sons of Ammon and Amalek, and he went and struck Israel, and they took possession of the city of palms.
en.B: Eglon gathered the Ammonites and the Amalekites to join him, and he went and defeated Israel, and they took over the City of Palms.
en.R: He got the Ammonites and the Amalekites to join him. Then he attacked Israel and beat them, and they took over Jericho, the City of Palms.

sw.L: Naye akawakusanya kwake wana wa Amoni na Amaleki, akaenda akampiga Israeli, nao wakaumiliki mji wa mitende.
sw.B: Egloni aliwakusanya Waamoni na Waamaleki waungane naye, akaenda akawashinda Israeli, nao wakautwaa Mji wa Mitende.
sw.R: Aliwashawishi Waamoni na Waamaleki waungane naye. Kisha akawashambulia Israeli na kuwashinda, nao wakautwaa Yeriko, Mji wa Mitende.

es.L: Y reunió consigo a los hijos de Amón y a Amalec, y fue e hirió a Israel, y tomaron posesión de la ciudad de las palmeras.
es.B: Eglón reunió a los amonitas y a los amalecitas para que se unieran a él, y fue y derrotó a Israel, y se apoderaron de la Ciudad de las Palmeras.
es.R: Consiguió que los amonitas y los amalecitas se unieran a él. Luego atacó a Israel y lo venció, y se apoderaron de Jericó, la Ciudad de las Palmeras.

fr.L: Et il rassembla auprès de lui les fils d’Ammon et Amalek, et il alla et frappa Israël, et ils prirent possession de la ville des palmiers.
fr.B: Églon rassembla les Ammonites et les Amalécites pour s’allier à lui ; il alla battre Israël, et ils s’emparèrent de la Ville des Palmiers.
fr.R: Il a obtenu que les Ammonites et les Amalécites se joignent à lui. Puis il a attaqué Israël et l’a battu, et ils se sont emparés de Jéricho, la Ville des Palmiers.

vi.L: Và vua tập hợp về mình con cái Am-môn và A-ma-léc, và vua đi đánh Y-sơ-ra-ên, và chúng chiếm lấy thành cây chà là.
vi.B: Éc-lôn liên kết với người Am-môn và người A-ma-léc, rồi đến đánh bại Y-sơ-ra-ên, và chúng chiếm thành Cây Chà Là.
vi.R: Vua ấy kêu gọi người Am-môn và người A-ma-léc theo mình. Rồi vua tấn công và đánh bại Y-sơ-ra-ên, và chúng chiếm lấy Giê-ri-cô, là thành Cây Chà Là.

ko.L: 그리고 그가 암몬 자손과 아말렉을 자기에게 모아 가서 이스라엘을 쳤고, 그들이 종려나무 성읍을 차지하였다.
ko.B: 에글론은 암몬 사람들과 아말렉 사람들을 모아 함께 가서 이스라엘을 쳐부수고, 종려나무 성읍을 차지하였다.
ko.R: 에글론은 암몬 사람들과 아말렉 사람들을 자기편으로 끌어들였다. 그리고 이스라엘을 공격하여 이기고, 종려나무 성읍인 여리고를 차지하였다.

pt.L: E ele reuniu consigo os filhos de Amom e Amaleque, e foi e feriu Israel, e tomaram posse da cidade das palmeiras.
pt.B: Eglom juntou a si os amonitas e os amalequitas, e foi e derrotou Israel, e eles se apossaram da Cidade das Palmeiras.
pt.R: Ele conseguiu que os amonitas e os amalequitas se juntassem a ele. Depois atacou Israel e o venceu, e eles tomaram Jericó, a Cidade das Palmeiras.

decisions.choice: Ammon and Amalek: Moab's allies
decisions.reason: The Ammonites lived east of the Jordan, north of Moab. The Amalekites were desert raiders and old enemies of Israel (Exodus 17:8-16).

decisions.choice: the city of palms: Jericho
decisions.reason: Jericho, an oasis city in the Jordan valley, is called the city of palm trees in Deuteronomy 34:3 and 2 Chronicles 28:15. Jericho had been destroyed and placed under a curse (Joshua 6:26), so this was probably a settlement at its spring. From there Moab held the crossing into Israel's land.

decisions.choice: they took possession: Eglon and his allies
decisions.reason: The verb changes from "he" to "they": Eglon leads, and the combined force occupies the city.

decisions.choice: Jericho, the City of Palms
decisions.reason: Readable names the city the phrase refers to.

source.text: וַיַּעַבְד֤וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֙ אֶת־עֶגְל֣וֹן מֶֽלֶךְ־מוֹאָ֔ב שְׁמוֹנֶ֥ה עֶשְׂרֵ֖ה שָׁנָֽה׃ס

records.literal_gloss: And served [the] sons of Israel Eglon king of Moab eighteen years.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel served Eglon king of Moab eighteen years.
en.B: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} served Eglon king of Moab for eighteen years.
en.R: The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} had to serve Eglon king of Moab for eighteen years.

sw.L: Nao wana wa Israeli wakamtumikia Egloni mfalme wa Moabu miaka kumi na minane.
sw.B: Waisraeli walimtumikia Egloni mfalme wa Moabu kwa miaka kumi na minane.
sw.R: Waisraeli walilazimika kumtumikia Egloni mfalme wa Moabu kwa miaka kumi na minane.

es.L: Y los hijos de Israel sirvieron a Eglón, rey de Moab, dieciocho años.
es.B: Los israelitas sirvieron a Eglón, rey de Moab, durante dieciocho años.
es.R: Los israelitas tuvieron que servir a Eglón, rey de Moab, durante dieciocho años.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël servirent Églon, roi de Moab, dix-huit ans.
fr.B: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} furent asservis à Églon, roi de Moab, pendant dix-huit ans.
fr.R: Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont dû servir Églon, roi de Moab, pendant dix-huit ans.

vi.L: Và con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên phục dịch Éc-lôn, vua Mô-áp, mười tám năm.
vi.B: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên phục dịch Éc-lôn, vua Mô-áp, trong mười tám năm.
vi.R: Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên phải phục dịch Éc-lôn, vua Mô-áp, trong mười tám năm.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 모압 왕 에글론을 십팔 년 동안 섬겼다.
ko.B: 이스라엘 백성은 십팔 년 동안 모압 왕 에글론을 섬겼다.
ko.R: 이스라엘 백성은 십팔 년 동안 모압 왕 에글론을 섬겨야 했다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Israel serviram Eglom, rei de Moabe, dezoito anos.
pt.B: Os israelitas serviram Eglom, rei de Moabe, por dezoito anos.
pt.R: Os israelitas tiveram de servir Eglom, rei de Moabe, por dezoito anos.

decisions.choice: served Eglon: lived as his subjects and paid him tribute
decisions.reason: Israel served the Baals (verse 7) and now must serve a foreign king. The tribute of verses 15-18 is part of that service. Eighteen years is more than twice the eight years under Cushan-rishathaim (verse 8).

source.text: וַיִּזְעֲק֣וּ בְנֵֽי־יִשְׂרָאֵל֮ אֶל־יְהוָה֒ וַיָּקֶם֩ יְהוָ֨ה לָהֶ֜ם מוֹשִׁ֗יעַ אֶת־אֵה֤וּד בֶּן־גֵּרָא֙ בֶּן־הַיְמִינִ֔י אִ֥ישׁ אִטֵּ֖ר יַד־יְמִינ֑וֹ וַיִּשְׁלְח֨וּ בְנֵי־יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל בְּיָדוֹ֙ מִנְחָ֔ה לְעֶגְל֖וֹן מֶ֥לֶךְ מוֹאָֽב׃

records.literal_gloss: And cried out [the] sons of Israel to Yahweh, and raised up Yahweh for them a deliverer, Ehud son of Gera, the Benjaminite, a man restricted [in the] hand of his right; and sent [the] sons of Israel by his hand tribute to Eglon king of Moab.

en.L: And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} raised up for them a deliverer, Ehud son of Gera, the Benjaminite, a man restricted [in] his right hand. And the {{gender:children|sons}} of Israel sent tribute by his hand to Eglon king of Moab.
en.B: Then the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, and {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} raised up a deliverer for them: Ehud son of Gera, from the tribe of Benjamin, a left-handed man. The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} sent him to take their tribute to Eglon king of Moab.
en.R: Then the {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} cried out to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} for help, and {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} gave them someone to rescue them. This was Ehud son of Gera, from the tribe of Benjamin. Ehud was left-handed. The {{gender:Israelites|sons of Israel}} sent him to take the payment they owed to Eglon king of Moab.

sw.L: Nao wana wa Israeli wakamlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawainulia mwokozi, Ehudi mwana wa Gera, Mbenyamini, mtu aliyezuiliwa [katika] mkono wake wa kuume. Nao wana wa Israeli wakapeleka kodi kwa mkono wake kwa Egloni mfalme wa Moabu.
sw.B: Kisha Waisraeli walimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, naye {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} akawainulia mwokozi: Ehudi mwana wa Gera, wa kabila la Benyamini, mtu aliyetumia mkono wa kushoto. Waisraeli walimtuma kupeleka kodi yao kwa Egloni mfalme wa Moabu.
sw.R: Kisha Waisraeli walimlilia {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} awasaidie, naye akawapa mtu wa kuwaokoa. Huyo alikuwa Ehudi mwana wa Gera, wa kabila la Benyamini. Ehudi alikuwa mtu wa mkono wa kushoto. Waisraeli walimtuma kupeleka malipo waliyodaiwa kwa Egloni mfalme wa Moabu.

es.L: Y clamaron los hijos de Israel {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les levantó un libertador, Aod hijo de Gera, benjamita, hombre impedido de su mano derecha. Y los hijos de Israel enviaron por su mano tributo a Eglón, rey de Moab.
es.B: Entonces los israelitas clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}, y {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} les levantó un libertador: Aod hijo de Gera, de la tribu de Benjamín, que era zurdo. Los israelitas lo enviaron a llevar su tributo a Eglón, rey de Moab.
es.R: Entonces los israelitas clamaron {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} pidiendo ayuda, y {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} les dio a alguien que los rescatara. Fue Aod hijo de Gera, de la tribu de Benjamín. Aod era zurdo. Los israelitas lo enviaron a llevar el pago que le debían a Eglón, rey de Moab.

fr.L: Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël crièrent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur suscita un libérateur, Éhoud, fils de Guéra, le Benjaminite, un homme empêché de la main droite. Et les {{gender:enfants|fils}} d’Israël envoyèrent par sa main un tribut à Églon, roi de Moab.
fr.B: Alors les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} crièrent {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}}, et {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} leur suscita un libérateur : Éhoud, fils de Guéra, de la tribu de Benjamin, un gaucher. Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} l’envoyèrent porter leur tribut à Églon, roi de Moab.
fr.R: Alors les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} ont appelé {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} au secours, et {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} leur a donné quelqu’un pour les délivrer. C’était Éhoud, fils de Guéra, de la tribu de Benjamin. Éhoud était gaucher. Les {{gender:Israélites|fils d’Israël}} l’ont envoyé porter à Églon, roi de Moab, le paiement qu’ils lui devaient.

vi.L: Và con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dấy lên cho họ một người giải cứu, Ê-hút con trai Ghê-ra, người Bên-gia-min, một người bị tật ở tay phải. Và con cháu Y-sơ-ra-ên gửi cống vật qua tay người cho Éc-lôn, vua Mô-áp.
vi.B: Bấy giờ dân Y-sơ-ra-ên kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, và {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} dấy lên cho họ một người giải cứu: Ê-hút con trai Ghê-ra, thuộc chi tộc Bên-gia-min, một người thuận tay trái. Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sai ông đem cống vật đến nộp cho Éc-lôn, vua Mô-áp.
vi.R: Rồi dân Y-sơ-ra-ên kêu cầu {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} giúp đỡ, và {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} ban cho họ một người để giải cứu họ. Đó là Ê-hút con trai Ghê-ra, thuộc chi tộc Bên-gia-min. Ê-hút thuận tay trái. Dân Y-sơ-ra-ên sai ông đem tiền cống họ phải nộp đến cho Éc-lôn, vua Mô-áp.

ko.L: 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖자, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 위하여 구원자를 일으키셨다. 그는 베냐민 사람 게라의 아들 에훗으로, 오른손이 묶인 사람이었다. 그리고 이스라엘 자손이 그의 손으로 모압 왕 에글론에게 조공을 보냈다.
ko.B: 그때 이스라엘 백성이 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖자, {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께서 그들을 위하여 구원자를 세우셨다. 그는 베냐민 지파 게라의 아들 에훗인데, 왼손잡이였다. 이스라엘 백성은 그를 시켜 모압 왕 에글론에게 조공을 바치게 하였다.
ko.R: 그때 이스라엘 백성이 도와 달라고 {{divine_name:주|야훼}}께 부르짖자, 주님께서 그들을 구해 낼 사람을 주셨다. 그는 베냐민 지파 게라의 아들 에훗이었다. 에훗은 왼손잡이였다. 이스라엘 백성은 모압 왕 에글론에게 바쳐야 할 돈과 물건을 에훗을 시켜 보냈다.

pt.L: E os filhos de Israel clamaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhes levantou um libertador, Eúde, filho de Gera, benjamita, homem impedido da mão direita. E os filhos de Israel enviaram por meio dele tributo a Eglom, rei de Moabe.
pt.B: Então os israelitas clamaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}}, e {{divine_name:o SENHOR|Javé}} lhes levantou um libertador: Eúde, filho de Gera, da tribo de Benjamim, um homem canhoto. Os israelitas o enviaram para levar o seu tributo a Eglom, rei de Moabe.
pt.R: Então os israelitas clamaram {{divine_name:ao SENHOR|a Javé}} pedindo ajuda, e {{deity_pronoun:ele|Ele}} lhes deu alguém para livrá-los. Era Eúde, filho de Gera, da tribo de Benjamim. Eúde era canhoto. Os israelitas o enviaram para levar o pagamento que deviam a Eglom, rei de Moabe.

decisions.choice: restricted in his right hand: left-handed
decisions.reason: The phrase describes a man who did not use his right hand, that is, a left-handed man. It may mean he was trained to fight with the left: 20:16 tells of 700 chosen left-handed men of Benjamin, and 1 Chronicles 12:2 of Benjaminites who used both hands. There is irony in the name: Benjamin means "son of the right hand".

decisions.choice: tribute: the payment owed by a subject people
decisions.reason: The word can mean a gift or a grain offering, but here it is the tribute a conquered people paid their overlord, in goods or silver (2 Samuel 8:2, where Moab pays tribute to David).

decisions.choice: by his hand: through him, with him as the one who carried it
decisions.reason: "By his hand" means Ehud was the agent who delivered the tribute.

decisions.choice: a left-handed man / Ehud was left-handed
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable give the meaning of the phrase. Literal keeps its form, "restricted in his right hand".

decisions.choice: the payment they owed
decisions.reason: "Tribute" is not a common word, so Readable explains it.

decisions.choice: "Aod"; "hombre impedido de su mano derecha" (L); "zurdo" (B, R)
decisions.reason: "Aod" is the usual Spanish form of the name, as the terms note for these books sets. The Hebrew says his right hand was restricted, which means he was left-handed (m1); Literal keeps the Hebrew picture and Balanced and Readable say "zurdo".
